prompts.canonical:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final transparent full-body sprite for Doodle Rumble 2D fighter.
Input image 1 is the child's pencil drawing: design motif reference. Image 2 Orange and image 3 Fuse are exact game's style references, not characters to copy.
Create ONE original character called Crackle based on image 1: a bold hollow-headed stick figure, black empty circular face encircled by thick ivory ink rim, wearing a DIAMOND helmet made of large angular pale cyan crystal facets and dark teal ink edges. Helmet is a squat faceted cap around the upper half of the round hollow head, clearly reads as diamond armor, not a face or realistic human. Small thin ivory stick torso bearing the simple diamond mark from sketch; thin substantial ink-outlined arms/legs. HUGE heavy angular ivory and cyan boots with long pointed toes, a major part of the silhouette. In left hand a chunky red-paper firework rocket launch tube inspired by the drawing, with a small gold starburst motif and stub fuse; in right hand a long graphite shaft spear tipped by a cyan faceted diamond blade. Side-view 3/4, facing RIGHT, confident neutral stance, spear rises diagonally to upper right, rocket tube on opposite side. All parts visible, full body.
Exact visual style of images2/3: uneven thick scratchy black ink outline, grainy marker fill, chipped ivory/cyan accents, dark graphite shadows, richly textured hand-drawn sketchbook game art. Same large hollow circular head-to-stick-limb proportions, readable at300px tall. Not a muscular person, chibi, knight anatomy, or smooth vector.
Transparent background with clean alpha. NO floor, shadow puddle, labels, text, panels, backdrop, glow haze. No baked particles or fire on character. One character only, ample padding no cropping. Preserve paper rocket, diamond helmet, spear, oversized boots.
